ranking: eligible candidates sorted by utility_score_candidate - 4*risk_score_candidate, then lower risk and option id
utility: expected_benefit + 3*intent_alignment + preference boost; resource pressure subtracts cost*5 or cost*8
constraints: hard constraint, permission, safety, role and evidence vetoes
uncertainty: unknown labels and explicit defer/contest/abstain states
expected_outcome: utility candidate only; no expectation object emitted
